contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [--]NVS AVG ; R/ VICTORIAE [LAETAE PRINC PERP]

Copper alloy coin fragment. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Two Victories issue of 318-320, Reece period 16; chipped. Obverse description: Bust helmeted and cuirassed right, tall plume on helmet, scale cuirass. Obverse inscription: [--]NVS AVG. Reverse description: Two Victories facing each other holding up wreath inscribed VOT / PR. Reverse inscription: VICTORIAE [LAETAE PRINC PERP].…
